rules.label: Visitors: up to 6 months per visit
notes: Guernsey is in the Common Travel Area with the UK and Ireland, so there are no routine passport checks when you arrive from there. Visitor rules are the same as the UK's: up to 6 months, and you can't live there through repeated visits.
Since April 2026, visitors arriving from outside the Common Travel Area need an ETA unless they hold a visa. A UK, Jersey, Guernsey or Isle of Man ETA is accepted by all four.
The app counts each place in the Common Travel Area separately. Time in the UK on the same trip isn't added to this count.

rules.label: Tax resident from 91 days in a calendar year
notes: A day counts if you're in the Bailiwick of Guernsey at midnight. The tax year is the calendar year.
You can be resident after only 35 days if you spent 365 or more days there in the previous 4 years.
182 days in the year, or 91 days plus 730 in the previous 4 years, makes you principally resident: taxed on worldwide income. Taking up permanent residence does the same from the day you arrive.
